509:t_001:30.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Do you think we're being inappropriate with the enemy right in front of us?」

509:t_001:31.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's not what I meant...!」

509:t_001:32.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Thinking is important, but I don't think we should overthink things either.」

509:t_001:34.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バナージ$$, $$ロラン$$, focus on what's in front of you for now.」

509:t_001:36.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're right... I guess Ensign $$リディ$$ was still weighing on my mind somewhere.」

509:t_001:38.en:
$$セツコ$$
「My teammates often helped ease my tension like this too.」

509:t_001:39.en:
$$セツコ$$
(And soon someone else who overthinks things and can't be honest with herself will come...)

509:t_001:40.en:
$$フェルト$$
「$$ネオ・ジオン$$ is coming!」

509:t_001:41.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, prepare to intercept!」

509:t_002:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「So $$ハマーン・カーン$$ has come!」

509:t_002:2.en:
$$クェス$$
「See... It was just like I said!」

509:t_002:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「She seems to be leading rather few units for $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s Supreme Commander...」

509:t_002:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「They're less an army of $$ネオ・ジオン$$ than people willing to follow me.」

509:t_002:6.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「$c... I will settle this in my own way.」

509:t_002:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$! $$ハマーン$$ is...!」

509:t_002:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ハマーン$$... As you know, the Colonel isn't here. Will you still fight?」

509:t_002:10.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That man has nothing to do with this. I merely fight as my heart dictates.」

509:t_002:11.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, your target is the $$キュベレイ$$! If we take down $$ハマーン$$, the battle will end!」

509:t_002:12.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Let me test you, $c! Are you worthy of $$シャア$$'s faith!?」

509:t_003:1.en:
$$シン$$
「So $$ハマーン・カーン$$ has come!」

509:t_003:2.en:

「See... It was just like I said!」

509:t_003:9.en:

509:t_003:10.en:
$$ハマーン$$

509:t_003:11.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, your target is the $$キュベレイ$$! If we take down $$ハマーン$$, the battle will end!」

509:t_003:12.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Let me test you, $c! Are you worthy of $$シャア$$'s faith!?」

509:t_004:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You're strong. You're stronger than me...」

509:t_004:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Now I can understand why $$シャア$$ abandoned me...」

509:t_004:4.en:
???
「Are you satisfied with dying like this, $$ハマーン・カーン$$?」

509:t_006:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「First, I'll have the small fry disappear.」

509:t_007:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Isn't $$ネオ・ジオン$$ cooperating with the Empire!?」

509:t_007:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$ネオ・ジオン$$ is. But these people are effectively $$ハマーン$$'s private troops.」

509:t_008:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$ハマーン・カーン$$... Do you intend to end your life here?」

509:t_008:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I challenged $c as a warrior, and I lost. The defeated can only die.」

509:t_008:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you were going to die anyway, didn't you want $$シャア・アズナブル$$ to kill you?」

509:t_008:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You can't stand that $$シャア$$'s heart is turned toward $$フロンタル$$, $$アムロ$$... even the world, rather than you.」

509:t_008:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You could have forgiven him if he'd still relied on you, but he pushed you away...」

509:t_008:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Of course you can't believe in the future he speaks of or the world he tries to protect.」

509:t_008:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You're a woman burdened by deep karma. The depth of your love makes your hatred grow too.」

509:t_008:10.en:
$$セツコ$$
「And she's grown weary of it, and is about to give herself over to grief...」

509:t_008:11.en:
$$シン$$
「So that's what you sensed, $$セツコ$$...」

509:t_008:12.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$ハマーン・カーン$$... Your ideal future was something you were meant to find together with $$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

509:t_008:13.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「But now that he's gone, you've learned that seeking it is meaningless, however much you want it.」

509:t_008:15.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You seem to be even more insolent than $$カミーユ・ビダン$$...!」

509:t_008:16.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Yes, that's it. You're most beautiful when you fight.」

509:t_008:17.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「So I'll release all the hatred inside you!」

509:t_008:18.en:
$n
「This is bad! It's the scorpion's poison!」

509:t_009:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Now, $$ハマーン・カーン$$! Fight as your hatred commands!」

509:t_010:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You scum...! Don't think someone like you can invade my mind!」

509:t_011:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「And I'll teach you this too! If you think all $$スペースノイド$$s wag their tails for you, you're sorely mistaken!」

509:t_012:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's impossible! My poison doesn't work!?」

509:t_012:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「She isn't as weak as you think.」

509:t_013:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'll support you, $$ハマーン・カーン$$.」
